## Quarto

```{r echo=FALSE}

library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)

penguins |>
  count(species)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
no_of_participants <- penguins |> nrow()
no_of_participants
```

The number of penguins is `r no_of_participants` for the year 2026.

The number of penguins is `r nrow(penguins)` for the year 2026.

One plus two is equal to `r 1+2`

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}


library(ggplot2)

ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Bill dimensions by species",
    x = "Bill length (mm)", y = "Bill depth (mm)", color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
library(kableExtra)
penguins |>
  count(species, island) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = island, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  kable(caption = "Penguins observed per island")
```
